https://www.fararu.com/fa/news/1013227/%.body: نتایج اولیه انتخابات اسرائیل، با پیشتازی ائتلاف بنیامین نتانیاهو با ۵۳ کرسی، بار دیگر بنبست سیاسی را رقم زده است؛ زیرا هیچ اردوگاهی به اکثریت ۶۱ کرسی نرسیده است. احزاب عربی با کسب ۱۹ کرسی و مشارکت گسترده رأیدهندگان عرب، به بازیگران تعیینکننده تبدیل شدهاند. اکنون مخالفان نتانیاهو باید درباره همکاری با این احزاب تصمیم بگیرند؛ تصمیمی که میتواند مسیر تشکیل دولت، ائتلافهای سیاسی یا انتخابات مجدد را مشخص کند. پ ، پـ تبلیغات تبلیغات فرارو- حسن لافی، تحلیلگر ارشد مسائل خاورمیانه در المیادین به گزارش فرارو به نقل از المیادین، نتایج اولیه انتخابات، با وجود پیشتازی نسبی ائتلاف بنیامین نتانیاهو، هیچیک از دو اردوگاه اصلی را به اکثریت پارلمانی نرسانده است. در این میان، احزاب عربی با کسب ۱۹ کرسی به بازیگر تعیینکننده معادلات تشکیل دولت تبدیل شدهاند؛ آزمونی که میزان آمادگی مخالفان نتانیاهو برای همکاری سیاسی با شهروندان فلسطینی اسرائیل را آشکار خواهد کرد. نتایج انتخابات اسرائیل، برخلاف تصویری که نظرسنجیهای نهایی ترسیم میکردند، بار دیگر بنبست سیاسی این کشور را بازتولید کرده است. بر اساس نتایج اولیه و پیش از پایان شمارش آرای پاکتهای دوتایی، اردوگاه نتانیاهو ۵۳ کرسی، اردوگاه تغییر ۴۸ کرسی و فهرستهای عربی مجموعاً ۱۹ کرسی به دست آوردهاند. هیچیک از دو اردوگاه اصلی به حد نصاب ۶۱ کرسی برای تشکیل دولت اکثریت نرسیده است. با این حال، اهمیت انتخابات فقط به محاسبات پارلمانی محدود نمیشود؛ نتایج، پیامهای سیاسی مهمی درباره جامعه یهودی اسرائیل و جایگاه شهروندان فلسطینی در ساختار سیاسی این کشور به همراه دارد. نتانیاهو شکست خورد، اما حذف نشد بنیامین نتانیاهو با وجود انتقادهای گسترده، مسئول دانسته شدن دولتش در ناکامی جلوگیری از حملات هفتم اکتبر، اختلافات بر سر قانون سربازی حریدیها و اصلاحات قضایی و همچنین بحرانهای امنیتی و سیاسی، همچنان توانسته است بخش قابلتوجهی از جامعه اسرائیل را با خود همراه نگه دارد. حزب لیکود با کسب ۲۶ کرسی همچنان بزرگترین حزب منفرد انتخابات است و اردوگاه نتانیاهو نیز در نتایج اولیه از رقیبان خود پیشی گرفته است. این وضعیت پرسشی اساسی ایجاد میکند: چگونه سیاستمداری که با چنین حجم از ناکامیها مواجه بوده، همچنان میتواند در صدر رقابتهای حزبی باقی بماند؟ پاسخ را نمیتوان صرفاً در قدرت تشکیلاتی لیکود یا مهارت نتانیاهو در مدیریت رقابتهای انتخاباتی جستوجو کرد. بخشی از جامعه راستگرای اسرائیل، او را نماینده پروژه سیاسی و ایدئولوژیک خود میداند و امنیت، هویت ملی و موضع سختگیرانه در برابر فلسطینیان را در اولویت قرار میدهد؛ حتی اگر اعتمادش به عملکرد دولت در دیگر حوزهها کاهش یافته باشد. از سوی دیگر، بخشی از این رأیدهندگان اردوگاه تغییر را جایگزینی قابلاعتماد نمیدانند یا توانایی آن را برای اداره کشور در محیطی منطقهای و بیثبات زیر سؤال میبرند. در چنین شرایطی، ناکامیهای دولت لزوماً به شکست انتخاباتی قاطع منجر نمیشود، مگر آنکه رقیبان بتوانند جایگزینی قابلقبول ارائه دهند. با این همه، نتانیاهو نیز بدون هزینه از انتخابات خارج نشده است. لیکود در مقایسه با انتخابات سال ۲۰۲۲، که ۳۲ کرسی به دست آورده بود، شش کرسی از دست داده است. ائتلاف او نیز با ۵۳ کرسی از اکثریت لازم فاصله دارد. بنابراین، نتانیاهو نتوانسته است اکثریتی برای تضمین ادامه حکومت خود فراهم کند، اما موفق شده است پایگاه انتخاباتی خود را برخلاف انتظار مخالفانش، تا حد زیادی حفظ کند. احزاب عربی؛ بازیگران تعیینکننده انتخابات مهمترین شگفتی انتخابات، صعود فهرستهای عربی به ۱۹ کرسی است؛ نتیجهای که آنها را بار دیگر به مرکز معادلات پارلمانی اسرائیل بازگردانده است. برآوردهای اولیه همچنین از مشارکت حدود ۸۰ درصدی شهروندان عرب حکایت دارد. اگر نتایج نهایی این ارقام را تأیید کند، مشارکت گسترده عربها نشانهای مهم از بسیج سیاسی در این جامعه خواهد بود. این افزایش مشارکت را نمیتوان جدا از شرایط سیاسی و اجتماعی سالهای اخیر تحلیل کرد. سیاستهای محدودکننده علیه فلسطینیان شهروند اسرائیل تشدید شده، بحران جرم و خشونت گسترش یافته و در بخشی از گفتمان سیاسی اسرائیل، شهروندان عرب بهعنوان تهدیدی برای هویت یهودی کشور معرفی شدهاند. پس از هفتم اکتبر نیز محدودیتها و برخوردها با ابراز همبستگی با فلسطینیان افزایش یافته است. در چنین فضایی، مشارکت گسترده عربها را میتوان فراتر از پاسخ به فراخوان احزاب برای افزایش رأیدهندگان ارزیابی کرد؛ این مشارکت پیامی اعتراضی درباره حق حضور سیاسی و مقابله با حاشیهرانی است. افزایش شمار نمایندگان عرب، علاوه بر تقویت حضور آنها در کنست، هزینه نادیده گرفتن این گروه را برای احزاب دیگر بالا برده است. با ۵۳ کرسی برای اردوگاه نتانیاهو، ۴۸ کرسی برای اردوگاه تغییر و ۱۹ کرسی برای فهرستهای عربی، هیچیک از دو اردوگاه اصلی نمیتواند نقش این احزاب را در محاسبات خود نادیده بگیرد؛ هرچند احزاب صهیونیستی همچنان درباره همکاری با آنها تردید دارند. اکنون انتخابات از آزمون نتانیاهو به آزمون مخالفان او تبدیل شده است. اردوگاه تغییر که وعده پایان دادن به حکومت نتانیاهو را داده، باید تصمیم بگیرد آیا حاضر است ملاحظات ایدئولوژیک خود درباره همکاری با احزاب عربی را کنار بگذارد و از ظرفیت آنها برای تشکیل دولت اقلیت برخوردار از حمایت عربها استفاده کند یا خیر. احمد طیبی، نماینده عرب کنست، از امکان حمایت از چنین دولتی سخن گفته است؛ اما تبدیل این پیشنهاد به توافق عملی، مستلزم آمادگی رهبران اردوگاه تغییر برای پذیرش هزینههای سیاسی آن است. برای سیاستمدارانی مانند نفتالی بنت، آویگدور لیبرمن و گادی آیزنکوت، عبور از سالها مخالفت با اتکا به احزاب عربی و تشکیل دولتی که بقایش به حمایت آنها وابسته باشد، آسان نخواهد بود. با این حال، دشواری این مسیر به معنای ناممکن بودن آن نیست. همچنین حمایت احزاب عربی از بیرون ائتلاف با مشارکت مستقیم آنها در دولت تفاوت دارد. پرسش اصلی دیگر این نیست که آیا احزاب عربی از نظر عددی قدرت تأثیرگذاری دارند، بلکه این است که آیا مخالفان نتانیاهو حاضرند این قدرت را بخشی از قواعد بازی پارلمانی بپذیرند یا همچنان آن را مانعی بدانند که باید از آن عبور کرد. چه کسی اسرائیل را اداره خواهد کرد؟ نتایج انتخابات نه تشکیل دولت جایگزین را تضمین میکند و نه بازگشت نتانیاهو به قدرت را قطعی میسازد. اردوگاهی که بیشترین کرسیها را در اختیار دارد، لزوماً قادر به تشکیل ائتلافی پایدار نیست؛ بهویژه زمانی که بقای دولت به حمایت احزابی وابسته باشد که برخی متحدان احتمالی حاضر به همکاری با آنها نیستند. مذاکرات ممکن است به تشکیل دولت اقلیت، دولت وحدت ملی در شرایطی استثنایی یا برگزاری انتخابات جدید منجر شود. اما در هر صورت، رأی شهروندان عرب نقطه آغاز مذاکرات را تغییر داده و احزاب اسرائیلی را ناچار کرده است واقعیتی پارلمانی را بپذیرند که حل آن صرفاً از طریق توافق میان جریانهای صهیونیستی ممکن نیست. شهروندان عرب با مشارکت انتخاباتی توانستهاند حضور خود را از موضوعی که احزاب اسرائیلی درباره حدود آن بحث میکنند، به عاملی مؤثر بر محاسبات قدرت تبدیل کنند. این تحول به معنای پایان تبعیض یا تضمین مشارکت واقعی در تصمیمگیری نیست، اما نشان میدهد حاشیهرانی سیاسی لزوماً توان اثرگذاری را از میان نمیبرد. تبلیغات نتانیاهو در بنبست، آیزنکوت بر سر دوراهی/ سرنوشت انتخابات اسرائیل چه میشود؟ طرح تازه متحدان نتانیاهو برای ماندن در قدرت مخالفان نتانیاهو در دوراهی سرنوشتساز مرز مشارکت آمریکا در جنگ اوکراین کجاست؟ بیشتر بدانید: اسرائیل بنیامین نتانیاهو گادی آیزنکوت تبلیغات سرنوشت دولت آینده اسرائیل چه میشود؟ آیزنکوت چگونه خشونت را شیکتر از نتانیاهو اجرا میکند؟ سرنوشت جنگ با ایران بعد از رفتن نتانیاهو

https://www.fararu.com/fa/news/1013224/%.body: تصاویر دوربینهای ترافیکی در ایالت آیووا آمریکا، لحظه برخورد یک مظنون در حال فرار با کامیون شرکت فدکس را نشان میدهد. زمانی که مظنون تلاش میکرد از دست نیروهای پلیس بگریزد با کامیون در تقاطع تصادف کرد. پ ، پـ تبلیغات تبلیغات تبلیغات خسارات اصابت موشک به باند فرودگاه عدن تعقیب و گریز پلیس با تصادف پایان یافت خرین تقلا برای بقا؛ موشخرما طعمه شاهین شد جواد عزتی و عباس جمشیدیفر در اکران بورسیه بیشتر بدانید: تصادف کامیون تعقیب و گریز پلیس تبلیغات لحظه هولناک آویزان ماندن کامیون از پل نجات معجزهآسای دختر موتورسوار پس از تصادف با کامیون نجات معجزهآسای دختر غرق در موبایل از زیر کامیون

https://www.fararu.com/fa/news/1013244/%.body: سخنگوی سپاه گفت: واقعیت تنگه هرمز در آسمان، زمین و دریا رقم میخورد؛ نه در فضای مجازی و اتاقهای جنگ رسانهای آمریکا. پ ، پـ تبلیغات تبلیغات سردار حسین محبی، سخنگوی سپاه در شبکه ایکس نوشت: «سنتکامِ کودک کش! بحران سوئز ۱۹۵۶ پرده از محدودیت قدرت بریتانیا برداشت؛ تاریخ گاه در گلوگاههای راهبردی ورق میخورد. ادعای مینروبی هرمز را با شواهد مستقل ثابت کنید، نه بیانیه! واقعیت تنگه هرمز در آسمان، زمین و دریا رقم میخورد؛ نه در فضای مجازی و اتاقهای جنگ رسانهای آمریکا.» تبلیغات واکنش سخنگوی سپاه به ادعای سنتکام درباره مینروبی هرمز وزارت اطلاعات: ۴ هسته عملیاتی گروه تروریستی منهدم شدند وزارت اطلاعات: بازداشت ۳ عامل ارسال اطلاعات به دشمن در جنوب شرق واکنش سپاه به ادعای سنتکام درباره مینروبی هرمز بیشتر بدانید: سپاه تنگه هرمز تبلیغات انفجار ۳ نفتکش هنگام عبور از مسیر غیرمجاز تنگه هرمز تنگه هرمز در معادله جنگ؛ راهبرد تازه ایران و محاسبات محتاطانه ترامپ توقف ۴ کشتی در ۲۴ ساعت گذشته با اخطار سپاه

https://www.fararu.com/fa/news/1013230/%.body: سپاه از شکار یک پهپاد جاسوسی آمریکایی در غرب تنگه هرمز خبر داد. پ ، پـ تبلیغات تبلیغات روابطعمومی نیروی دریایی سپاه اعلام کرد: «یک پهپاد جاسوسی و فریب ارتش تروریست امریکا از نوع (MQM-170) در غرب تنگه هرمز پس از کشف، بهصورت سالم بر زمین فرود آورده شد. ماموریت این پهپاد، شناسایی سامانههای پدافند هوایی جمهوری اسلامی ایران در نوار ساحلی خلیج فارس و تنگهٔ هرمز بود. با اطلاعات بازیابیشدهٔ این پرنده، مشخص شد مبدأ پرواز این هواگرد در سواحل یکی کشورهای حاشیهٔ جنوبی خلیج فارس بوده است.» تبلیغات واکنش سخنگوی سپاه به ادعای سنتکام درباره مینروبی هرمز وزارت اطلاعات: ۴ هسته عملیاتی گروه تروریستی منهدم شدند وزارت اطلاعات: بازداشت ۳ عامل ارسال اطلاعات به دشمن در جنوب شرق واکنش سپاه به ادعای سنتکام درباره مینروبی هرمز بیشتر بدانید: سپاه تبلیغات انهدام یک فروند پهپاد پیشرفته MQ۱ در تنگه هرمز فرمانده نیروی دریایی سپاه: آمریکاییها ۷۰۰ کیلومتر از تنگه هرمز فاصله گرفتهاند فرمانده سپاه تهران: خود را برای جنگ ترکیبی تمامعیار آماده کردهایم

https://www.fararu.com/fa/news/1013239/%.body: آزادکار وزن ۶۵ کیلوگرم ایران با شکست ثانیه پایانی مقابل حریف ارمنی از رسیدن به نیمه نهایی قهرمانی جهان بازماند. پ ، پـ تبلیغات تبلیغات در ادامه رقابت های روز نخست کشتی آزاد قهرمانی جهان ۲۰۲۶ در قزاقستان، رحمان عموزاد نماینده وزن ۶۵ کیلوگرم ایران و دارنده ۲ مدال طلای جهان و یک نقره المپیک، در سومین مبارزه مقابلوازکن توانیان دارنده مدال برنز جهان از ارمنستان در حالیکه تا ثانیه پایانی با نتیجه ۲ بر یک پیس بود به دلیل تکرار حرکت رو به عقب و چرخیدن دور تشک، اخطار پوئن دریافت کرد و ناباورانه با نتیجه ۲ بر ۲ شکست خورد. با رد اعتراض کادر فنی ایران پس از بررسی فیلم، یک امتیاز دیگر به کشتی گیر ارمنی داده شد تا عموزاد با نتیجه ۳ بر ۲ تن به شکست بدهد. کشتی گیر ارمنی در دور بعد در یک مبارزه سخت باید به ماصف شامیل ممداف کشتی گیر عنوان دار و روسی الاصل بلغارستان برود که در صورت باخت، عموزاد از دور رقابت ها کنار خواهد رفت. عموزاد پیش از این در دور نخست مقابل موسایف کشتی گیر روسی الاصل بلژیک با نتیجه ۱۳ بر ۲ به برتری رسید و در ددمین مبارزه نیز ۹ بر صفر از سد دومان از ترکیه گذشت. حسن یزدانی دیگر نماینده ایران در روز نخست این رقابت ها، پس از پیروزی مقابل حریف کره ای، در دومین مبارزه برابر آرش یوشیدا کشتی گیر دورگه ایرانی - ژاپنی با نتیجه ۷ بر ۵ شکست خورد. تبلیغات ورود سگ به زمین، مسابقه فوتبال را متوقف کرد شوک دوم؛ شکست رحمان عموزاد مقابل کشتیگیر ارمنی ببینید؛ شکست ۷ بر ۵ حسن یزدانی مقابل آرش یوشیدا شوک بزرگ؛ شکست حسن یزدانی مقابل آرش یوشیدا بیشتر بدانید: کشتی آزاد رحمان عموزاد تبلیغات ببینید؛ پیروزی ۹ بر صفر رحمان عموزاد مقابل رقیب ترکیهای صعود قاطع رحمان عموزاد به یک چهارم نهایی قهرمانی کشتی جهان ببینید؛ پیروزی مقتدرانه رحمان عموزاد با امتیاز عالی

https://www.fararu.com/fa/news/1013213/%.body: دلار آزاد برخلاف روند کاهشی نرخ طلا و سکه رشد قیمت جزئی را تجربه کرد پ ، پـ تبلیغات تبلیغات فرارو - قیمت دلار امروز پنجشنبه 7 آبان با شروع معاملات در بازار به 270 هزار و 160 تومان رسید. به گزارش فرارو ؛ قیمت دلار آزاد کمتر از هزار تومان رشد پیدا کرد اما طلا و سکه روند کاهشی را در پیش گرفتند. قیمت هر گرم طلا 18 عیار 152 هزار تومان پایین آمد و به 26 میلیون و 248 هزار تومان رسید. سکه امامی نیز کاهش قیمت جزئی 30 هزار تومانی را ثبت کرد و اکنون هر قطعه آن 268 میلیون و 640 هزار تومان به فروش میرسد. انواع ارز، طلا و سکه قیمت دلار آزاد 270 هزار و 160 تومان هر گرم طلا 18 عیار 26 میلیون و 248 هزار تومان سکه امامی 268 میلیون و 640 هزار تومان سکه تمامبهار آزادی طرح قدیم 258 میلیون و 720 هزار تومان نیمسکه بهار آزادی 140 میلیون و 900 هزار تومان ربعسکه بهار آزادی 76 میلیون و 360 هزار تومان سکه گرمی 38 میلیون و 210 هزار تومان تبلیغات قیمت سکه پارسیان امروز پجشنبه ۷ آبان ۱۴۰۵ قیمت طلا دستدوم امروز پنجشنبه ۷ آبان ۱۴۰۵ نرخ تورم اجاره مسکن در مهر مشخص شد قیمت دلار، طلا و سکه امروز پنجشنبه ۷ آبان ۱۴۰۵ بیشتر بدانید: قیمت دلار قیمت طلا قیمت سکه تبلیغات قیمت گوشی سامسونگ، شیائومی و آیفون امروز پنجشنبه ۷ آبان ۱۴۰۵ قیمت محصولات ایرانخودرو و سایپا امروز پنجشنبه ۷ آبان ۱۴۰۵

https://24.kg/en/article/kyrgyzstan-stre.body: Kyrgyzstan continues to strengthen its national epidemiological surveillance system and preparedness for infectious disease threats by advancing the One Health approach, which promotes coordinated action to protect human, animal and environmental health. According to the Ministry of Health, as infectious diseases know no borders, the early detection of dangerous pathogens, effective laboratory operations, specialist training and cooperation among different agencies are becoming increasingly important in preventing outbreaks and future pandemics. On September 27, Health Minister Damir Osmonov presented Kyrgyzstan’s position on strengthening global pandemic preparedness at the United Nations General Assembly. In his address, he outlined the country’s experience in consistently implementing the One Health approach and identified priorities including stronger epidemiological surveillance, modernized laboratory infrastructure, workforce development and improved preparedness for biological threats. Achieving these goals requires not only stronger healthcare system capabilities but also sustained cross-sector cooperation involving government agencies, specialized services and international partners. A practical continuation of these efforts was a roundtable held in Bishkek on preventing epidemics and pandemics through the One Health approach. The event brought together representatives of government agencies, the U.S. Embassy in Kyrgyzstan and international organizations. Participants discussed the results of ongoing work and further steps to improve epidemiological surveillance, strengthen laboratory capacity, train specialists and coordinate the work of different agencies. This format of cooperation helps align approaches to detecting and preventing infectious disease threats, including diseases that can spread between animals and humans. The EpiC project is making an important contribution to strengthening Kyrgyzstan’s healthcare system. In 2026, the project supported the following achievements: 275 specialists from 49 districts received training in the implementation and use of the I-EPID electronic epidemiological surveillance system. The digital notification system was upgraded to automatically generate alerts about diseases of epidemiological significance. Training programs were developed and introduced for healthcare workers on plague, anthrax, brucellosis and rabies. Epidemiologists, veterinary specialists and sanitary quarantine service staff also received training. Eleven autoclaves were supplied and installed at healthcare facilities and laboratories to ensure the safe treatment of medical waste. Information materials on preventing and protecting against dangerous infectious diseases were developed, taking into account recommendations from local communities. These measures are helping improve specialist preparedness, strengthen epidemiological surveillance mechanisms and enable a faster response to potential threats to public health.

https://24.kg/en/article/number-of-worke.body: Over the past five years, Kyrgyzstan’s quota for foreign workers has increased sixfold, reaching 100,000 people. Chinese citizens account for the largest share. The Ministry of Labor, Social Security and Migration told 24.kg news agency . According to the ministry, the quota stood at just over 16,000 people in 2022 and 2023. It was raised to 25,000 in 2024, then to 52,000, before surging to 100,000 in 2026. Chinese citizens receive the largest number of work permits. Ministry data show that their numbers have grown annually, increasing more than fivefold over the past two years. A similar trend has been observed among Pakistani citizens. The number of permits issued to Bangladeshi citizens has followed a different pattern: after a sharp increase in 2025, the figure declined in 2026. Citizens of India and Uzbekistan also account for a notable share of foreign workers receiving permits in Kyrgyzstan. As of October 1, 2026, they had been issued 2,652 and 2,182 permits, respectively. The figures for these two countries have remained relatively stable in recent years. In previous years, Kyrgyzstan also issued work permits to Turkish citizens: 1,892 in 2022 and 1,480 in 2024. In 2022, 303 permits were issued to South Korean citizens. Neither country appears on this year’s list of permit recipients. Ministry explains increase in foreign worker quota by economic needs First Deputy Minister of Labor, Social Security and Migration Arlen Aliyasov said the quota for foreign workers is determined based on applications from employers, the needs of different economic sectors and the possibility of filling vacancies with Kyrgyz citizens. According to Aliyasov, foreign specialists are needed for major infrastructure and investment projects, as well as in industry, mining, metallurgy and garment manufacturing, where there is a shortage of skilled workers. "The annual quota must be determined on the basis of objectively confirmed demand for foreign labor, while balancing employers’ interests, protecting the domestic labor market and creating favorable conditions for investment,” Aliyasov said. The ministry believes that the effectiveness of the quotas and their role in addressing labor shortages should be assessed annually. At the same time, its priorities remain developing the domestic labor market, providing vocational training and expanding employment opportunities for Kyrgyz citizens. Arlen Aliyasov also noted that Kyrgyzstan remains both a country of origin for labor migrants and a destination for foreign workers. Kyrgyz citizens often seek higher wages abroad, while some domestic industries need additional workers and specialists with specific qualifications.

https://24.kg/en/article/china-kyrgyzsta.body: Construction of the China–Kyrgyzstan–Uzbekistan railway is expected to reach 22 percent of the total planned work by the end of 2026. Ulan Kulov, deputy director general of China–Kyrgyzstan–Uzbekistan Railway Company, said on Birinchi Radio. According to Kulov, construction is underway simultaneously at 11 sites along the Kyrgyz section of the railway, with 11 subcontractors involved. "We plan to complete 22 percent of the total construction work by the end of the year. At the same time, we expect to exceed the annual target by approximately 10 percent,” Kulov said. He reported that tunnel excavation is 21.5 percent complete, bridge pile foundation work has reached 95 percent, and earthworks are 67 percent complete. A total of 29 tunnels with a combined length of 104 kilometers and 50 bridges spanning approximately 25 kilometers are planned for the Kyrgyz section. The first tunnel, Kosh-Dobo-2, measuring 209 meters, was fully excavated in August 2026. However, no bridges have been fully completed yet. Installation of the first bridge structures is scheduled to begin in 2027. Construction in high-altitude terrain poses a particular challenge. According to Kulov, some sections of the railway run at elevations of up to 3,600 meters above sea level. More than 10,000 people are currently working on the project. Since construction began, more than 3,000 jobs have been created for Kyrgyz citizens. Three training centers have also been established, providing training and professional development to approximately 1,800 Kyrgyz citizens. The railway will extend for 304 kilometers across Kyrgyzstan. Under the approved schedule, construction is expected to take six years, with the railway scheduled to enter service in 2031. However, contractors hope to complete the project ahead of schedule, in 2030. "We are working to finish construction ahead of schedule. However, the project passes through challenging mountainous terrain. Unexpected difficulties arise during tunnel excavation, including changes in ground conditions, rockfalls and groundwater,” Kulov noted. He emphasized that the railway will serve both freight and passenger traffic, with trains designed to move at speeds of up to 140 kilometers per hour.

https://24.kg/en/article/kyrgyzstan-prep.body: Residents of Kyrgyzstan will be able to travel directly to China by passenger train once construction of the China–Kyrgyzstan–Uzbekistan railway is completed. Ulan Kulov, deputy director general of China–Kyrgyzstan–Uzbekistan Railway Company, said on Birinchi Radio. According to Kulov, the new railway will serve both freight and passenger traffic. "Passenger services will certainly be provided. This railway is designed for both freight and passenger transportation. Once it enters service, it will be possible to travel directly from Kyrgyzstan to China by train,” Ulan Kulov said. The company plans to purchase modern trains and high-comfort passenger carriages. According to the railway company representative, it is considering technologies already used on China’s railway network when selecting rolling stock. "China currently operates very comfortable passenger carriages. You have probably seen a video in which a cup of tea placed on a table barely moves while the train is in motion. We also plan to purchase such carriages and provide similar conditions for our passengers,” he noted. Possible passenger train routes are currently being considered. Specific destinations, timetables and ticket prices have not yet been determined. Trains on the China–Kyrgyzstan–Uzbekistan railway are designed to operate at speeds of up to 140 kilometers per hour. The Kyrgyz section of the railway will be 304 kilometers long and will include 29 tunnels and 50 bridges. Under the approved schedule, the railway is due to enter service in 2031. However, construction teams hope to complete the project ahead of schedule, in 2030, provided no unforeseen technical difficulties arise. The new railway will establish a direct rail link between Kyrgyzstan and China and expand opportunities for international passenger and freight transportation.

https://24.kg/en/article/kyrgyzstan-woul.body: Kyrgyzstan would like to receive larger shipments of fuel and lubricants from Russia. Kanatbek Eshatov, head of the country's Association of Oil Traders, told journalists. According to Eshatov, fuel supplies from Russia continue, but Kyrgyzstan would like to import petroleum products in larger volumes. Related news Kyrgyzstan begins receiving fuel shipments from China by rail He added that Kyrgyz companies have always sought ways to diversify their supplies. For example, petroleum products are also imported from Belarus and Turkey. "We have purchased certain volumes from some European countries as well. In particular, petroleum products were also imported from Italy,” the head of the association said. The current situation is linked to rising petroleum product prices, which are a direct consequence of escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. This has driven up purchase prices worldwide. In spring 2026, the Cabinet of Ministers decided to provide direct state subsidies to Kyrgyzstan's oil traders.

https://24.kg/en/article/west-asks-centr.body: Representatives of Western countries have increasingly approached the leaders of Central Asian republics with requests to host military bases, citing the region’s geographical proximity to Afghanistan. CSTO Secretary General Taalatbek Masadykov said this during a video conference. According to Masadykov, the leaders of Central Asian countries, both members and non-members of the Collective Security Treaty Organization (CSTO), have consistently rejected such requests. One reason, he said, is that the countries have managed to resolve their regional differences on their own. He added that Russia’s military presence in Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan has a positive impact on the situation in both countries and across Central Asia as a whole. Russian forces remain stationed in both republics, and their authorities have no plans to reconsider the arrangement. The region has no interest in hosting the forces of other countries, Masadykov said. Some Central Asian republics, including Kyrgyzstan, have experience hosting Western military personnel and are not prepared to return to that arrangement, he added. The CSTO chief cited the peaceful resolution of territorial disputes between Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan and Tajikistan through negotiations as an example of the region’s ability to address its own challenges. According to Masadykov, this demonstrates that neighboring countries can reach agreements peacefully and work together to respond to various security threats. "I am confident that the political will and wisdom of Central Asian leaders will enable them to resolve issues peacefully and relatively quickly and respond to any challenges that may arise,” he said. The agreement to establish the Ganci Air Base in Kyrgyzstan for the duration of the anti-terrorist operation in Afghanistan was signed on December 4, 2001. The air base was closed in winter 2009.

https://24.kg/en/article/kyrgyzstan-begi.body: Shipments of fuel and lubricants from China to Kyrgyzstan by rail began arriving, Kanatbek Eshatov, president of the Association of Oil Traders, said at a meeting on ensuring the country's energy security. According to Eshatov, Kyrgyzstan previously imported most of its fuel and lubricants from Russia. Supplies are now also coming from Azerbaijan, Turkmenistan, Belarus and Turkey. Earlier, fuel deliveries from China began by road. Today, the first shipments from China have also started arriving by rail. Eshatov noted that the situation with diesel fuel in Kyrgyzstan is currently stable. However, the country is experiencing a slight gasoline shortage and has been unable to procure the desired volumes. As a result, Kyrgyzstan is seeking alternative fuel suppliers and working to increase import volumes.

https://en.kabar.kg/news/kyrgyzstan-shar.body: Presidential administration Bishkek, Oct. 29, 2026 /Kabar/. Secretary of the Security Council of Kyrgyzstan Adilet Orozbekov participated in the Hedayah International Research Conference (IRC) 2026. The conference focused on pressing issues related to the prevention of and countering extremism, including the repatriation, rehabilitation, and reintegration of individuals. The conference featured expert discussions and an exchange of practical experience among representatives of government bodies and international organizations. Participants also presented academic research, as well as practices for developing state policy and implementing programs aimed at preventing and countering extremism. In his opening remarks, the Secretary of the Security Council of the Kyrgyz Republic briefed conference participants on the work being carried out in the country to prevent and counter extremism, including measures for the repatriation, rehabilitation, and reintegration of citizens. Special attention was given to the Kyrgyz Republic’s cooperation with international partners, most notably UNICEF, which has supported initiatives focused on the repatriation and reintegration of citizens, including children and their family members. This collaboration helps create the necessary conditions for citizens to return to a peaceful life, facilitating their social adaptation and reintegration into society, with the best interests of the child as a primary consideration. https://www.azernews.az/nation/266450.ht.body: Azerbaijan, Russia pledge to deepen cooperation in legal affairs 29 October 2026 15:48 (UTC+04:00) Ulviyya Poladova Read more Azerbaijan’s Prosecutor General Kamran Aliyev met with his Russian counterpart, Alexander Gutsan, in Baku on October 29 to discuss bilateral cooperation between the two countries’ prosecution authorities. Gutsan visited Baku at the invitation of Aliyev to attend the third high-level meeting of heads of anti-corruption law enforcement agencies of the member states of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation. During his visit, Gutsan paid tribute to national leader Heydar Aliyev at the Alley of Honor, laying a wreath at his grave. He also visited the grave of prominent ophthalmologist and academician Zarifa Aliyeva. During the meeting, Kamran Aliyev highlighted the importance of friendship, mutual understanding, trust and mutual assistance in Azerbaijan-Russia relations. The sides emphasized the role of Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev and Russian President Vladimir Putin in strengthening ties between the two countries and their peoples, noting the significance of meetings and contacts between the two leaders. Aliyev said that long-standing and effective cooperation had been established between the prosecution authorities of Azerbaijan and Russia, stressing the importance of further expanding ties in areas of mutual interest. The parties discussed the prompt and effective processing of requests for mutual legal assistance, the extradition of individuals accused or convicted of crimes, and the exchange of experience and best practices in law enforcement. They also highlighted the importance of the Statement of Intent on the Development of Cooperation, signed by the Prosecutor General’s Offices of Azerbaijan and Russia on April 9, 2021, in advancing collaboration in these areas. Gutsan thanked his Azerbaijani counterpart for the warm reception and underscored the importance of the existing cooperation between the two countries’ prosecution authorities. The meeting also covered tasks related to the implementation of the 2027-2028 Cooperation Program between the two prosecutor general’s offices, discussed in September in Kazan, as well as ways to improve international legal cooperation and prospects for further developing bilateral ties. In recognition of his contribution to effective cooperation and strengthening relations with Azerbaijan’s prosecution authorities, Gutsan was awarded the Azerbaijani jubilee medal "100th Anniversary of the Prosecutor’s Office of Azerbaijan (1918–2018)" by Kamran Aliyev. Following the meeting, the Russian delegation visited the History Museum of the Prosecutor’s Office of Azerbaijan. Russian Ambassador to Azerbaijan Mikhail Yevdokimov also attended the meeting. https://www.azernews.az/business/266443..body: Azerbaijan rules out new restrictions on Bank Melli Iran despite sanctions 29 October 2026 14:56 (UTC+04:00) Akbar Novruz Read more Azerbaijan's Central Bank has no plans to impose additional restrictions on the operations of Bank Melli Iran's Baku branch, despite the Iranian financial institution remaining subject to US sanctions, Central Bank Governor Taleh Kazimov said on Thursday. Speaking at a press conference on the Central Bank's interest rate corridor decision, Kazimov emphasised that the Iranian bank's presence in Azerbaijan's financial sector remained negligible and that its operations complied with domestic regulatory requirements. According to Trend, the governor said the bank's market share was close to zero, adding that Azerbaijani authorities did not envisage further measures against the institution. "It has been under sanctions for years and continues its activities with Azerbaijan, and we have no plans regarding any new restrictions. It complies with the requirements of the Central Bank of Azerbaijan. We do not envisage any measures being taken by the country. The bank has been operating in the market of Azerbaijan for a long time and understands the rules. That is, we do not face any problems," Kazimov stated. His remarks indicate that Azerbaijan intends to maintain its existing regulatory approach towards Bank Melli Iran, notwithstanding the international sanctions imposed on the Iranian lender. The governor's assessment of the bank's limited market presence is also reflected in its relatively modest financial operations in Azerbaijan, although the institution has continued to generate profits through its Baku branch. Bank Melli Iran's revenues rise in 2025 despite falling profits Financial statements from Bank Melli Iran's Baku branch show that the institution generated total revenues of AZN 5.746 million (approximately $3.38 million) in 2025, representing a 12.7% increase compared with AZN 5.097 million ($3 million) in 2024. According to financial data examined by FED.az, interest income accounted for AZN 5.666 million ($3.33 million), or 98.6% of total revenues. Commission income reached approximately AZN 23,000 ($13,500), while foreign exchange operations generated AZN 53,000 ($31,200). Despite the increase in revenues, the bank's net profit declined by 42.8% to AZN 4.412 million ($2.60 million), compared with AZN 7.716 million ($4.54 million) in 2024. Its total assets stood at AZN 120.29 million ($70.76 million) at the end of 2025, increasing by approximately 1% year-on-year. Profitability continues to weaken in 2026 The bank's latest financial results indicate that profitability continued to decline during the first nine months of 2026. Between January and September, the Baku branch recorded net profit of AZN 3.144 million ($1.85 million), down 28.2% from AZN 4.378 million ($2.58 million) during the corresponding period of 2025. Interest income decreased by 8.4% to AZN 3.935 million ($2.31 million), while total assets fell by 5% from the beginning of the year to AZN 114.28 million ($67.22 million). Nevertheless, the bank's outstanding customer loans increased by 20.9% to AZN 2.793 million ($1.64 million), while its total capital rose by 5.9% to AZN 56.50 million ($33.23 million). The figures suggest that although Bank Melli Iran has maintained a profitable operation in Azerbaijan, its earnings and asset base have come under pressure in 2026. The Central Bank's latest position indicates that these developments, alongside the institution's longstanding sanctions exposure, have not prompted Azerbaijani regulators to consider additional restrictions. Tags: Iran Sanctions Bank Melli Iran Central Bank of Azerbaijan (CBA) Azerbaijan’s banking sector

https://www.trend.az/casia/4240607.html.body: Home Central Asia Central Asia emerging as key geopolitical, economic hub - Turkmen parliament speaker Central Asia News 29 October 2026 12:10 (UTC +04:00) Photo: Uzbekistan's “BARAKA” Service Fuad Namazov Journalist Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 29. Central Asia is emerging as one of the world's key geopolitical and economic centers, creating opportunities to expand regional cooperation and strengthen stability, Chairperson of the Mejlis (Parliament) of Turkmenistan Dunyagozel Gulmanova said. This was reflected in a press release published by the Mejlis of Turkmenistan following Gulmanova’s speech at the 4th Interparliamentary Forum of Central Asian States, held today in Dushanbe. “The Central Asian region has currently evolved into one of the world’s most significant geopolitical and economic hubs, fostering multilateral cooperation among nations and serving as a key guarantor of stability,” the press release quoted Gulmanova as saying. She also emphasized that Turkmenistan's goals and objectives are focused on ensuring peace, establishing dialogue between countries, and strengthening mutual trust. These priorities are reflected in the region's growing engagement with international partners, as Central Asian countries expand cooperation through a series of high-level regional formats. In November 2025, the leaders of the five Central Asian countries met with U.S. President Donald Trump in Washington for the C5+1 summit marking the platform's 10th anniversary. In April 2025, the European Union and Central Asian countries established a strategic partnership at their first summit in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, while Japan held its first summit with the region's five states at the leaders' level in December 2025. The first Korea-Central Asia summit followed in Seoul in September 2026, focusing on industrial cooperation, critical minerals and supply chains. The region's expanding international engagement has coincided with growing trade ties. China's trade in goods with Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan reached $106.3 billion in 2025, up 12% year on year and exceeding the $100-billion mark for the first time, according to China's Ministry of Commerce. China also became the region's largest trading partner for the first time. Another important factor is logistics. The Middle Corridor, an international multimodal transport route linking China and Central Asia with the South Caucasus and Europe across the Caspian Sea, has gained importance as countries seek to diversify trade routes and strengthen supply-chain resilience. According to data cited by the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE), cargo volumes along the Trans-Caspian route rose by 62% in 2024 to 4.5 million tons. In the period from January through August 2026, freight volumes exceeded 3 million tons, up 11% year on year, according to Azerbaijan Railways (ADY). The growth has prompted investment in railways, ports and logistics facilities. In February 2026, the World Bank approved an $846 million guarantee to help mobilize $1.4 billion in commercial financing for a railway connectivity project in Kazakhstan. Meanwhile, upgrades at the Caspian ports of Aktau and Kuryk are aimed at improving cargo handling and increasing the route's capacity. The World Bank estimates that at least $25 billion in physical infrastructure investment will be needed along the corridor through 2040, in addition to an estimated $30 billion for logistics hubs, connecting links and other supporting infrastructure. Meanwhile, the European Union has stepped up its engagement with Central Asia as it seeks to strengthen transport links and diversify its trade routes. At the first EU-Central Asia summit in Samarkand in April 2025, the sides elevated their relations to a strategic partnership, with Brussels announcing a €12 billion Global Gateway investment package covering connectivity and other sectors. The EU has since promoted the Trans-Caspian route through investment forums and infrastructure planning. In September 2026, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced an ambition to mobilize up to €12 billion in public and private investment for the Middle Corridor. Azerbaijan has also strengthened its role in regional cooperation and transport connectivity. In November 2025, the five Central Asian states agreed to grant Azerbaijan full participation in their Consultative Meeting format, a decision followed by an informal meeting of the six countries' leaders in Cholpon-Ata, Kyrgyzstan, on July 31, 2026. The expanded format was subsequently reflected in the eighth Consultative Meeting, held in Turkmenistan’s Turkmenbashi on October 8, where Azerbaijan participated as a full member. The development has reinforced political coordination between Central Asia and the South Caucasus, including on trade, energy and transport links. This growing regional cooperation also has an important logistical dimension, with Azerbaijan serving as a key link between Central Asia and markets in the South Caucasus, Türkiye and Europe. Through the Middle Corridor, cargo transported across the Caspian Sea can reach Azerbaijan's ports and railway network before continuing westward. The route's growing importance has been accompanied by efforts to expand transport infrastructure and improve connectivity across the Caspian, strengthening economic ties between Central Asia and the South Caucasus. Energy resources are another major factor shaping Central Asia's role in global trade. Kazakhstan is a major oil exporter, while Turkmenistan is a leading natural gas supplier to China, and Uzbekistan also exports uranium. Kazakhstan's oil and uranium exports are important to European markets, while China remains a key destination for the region's hydrocarbons. The European Union has also stepped up energy cooperation with Central Asian countries, reflecting its interest in diversifying supplies and developing renewable energy. Against this backdrop, Gulmanova's description of Central Asia as an increasingly important geopolitical and economic center reflects the region's growing international engagement, expanding trade ties and rising importance as a transport link between Asia and Europe. For Turkmenistan, these developments reinforce the importance of regional stability, peaceful dialogue and mutual trust as foundations for strengthening cooperation among Central Asian states and their international partners. https://kun.uz/en/news/2026/10/29/four-c.body: Kun.uz has reviewed the court ruling in the case involving Garden Catering Trade LLC, which supplied prepared meals to state kindergartens in Fergana and Kuvasay. The company’s head, director, technologist and accountant were found guilty of offenses including violations of sanitary regulations, embezzlement, theft and document forgery. The court found that the company’s officials had misappropriated public funds through falsified reports and supplied contaminated meat-stuffed dolma to kindergartens in February 2026. The Furqat District Criminal Court issued its verdict on September 21, 2026. How the children were poisoned On February 20, Garden Catering Trade delivered meat-stuffed dolma to kindergartens in Fergana. The following day, 105 children suffered mass food poisoning. According to the court ruling, the company failed to comply with food safety requirements, including rules limiting how long prepared first and second courses could be kept on a stove to two hours and prohibiting reheating. An epidemiological investigation found that the children had eaten the dolma at their kindergartens on February 20 and were subsequently diagnosed with acute diarrhea of foodborne origin. Laboratory tests conducted by the regional Sanitary and Epidemiological Welfare and Public Health Department detected Salmonella enteritidis and Staphylococcus aureus in samples of the dolma supplied to kindergartens No. 2, 15, 22, 31, 58 and 61 in Fergana. Of 316 swab samples taken from the company’s kitchen, 80 contained bacteria from the intestinal bacteria group and 10 tested positive for Staphylococcus aureus. Inspectors also found that 11,461 kg of table salt, 1,528 kg of cucumbers and 9,050 kg of flour delivered to the company’s food warehouse were substandard and removed them from use. Embezzlement and falsified reports The court found that the company’s officials had inflated the number of children listed in daily meal plans and submitted false reports to obtain payments, misappropriating UZS 330.8 million in public funds. They also falsified records claiming that children had received their full prescribed portions of food, including 1,270 kg of butter worth UZS 79.853 million and 2,447 kg of meat products worth UZS 183.5 million. The court ruling states that the officials submitted claims for a total of UZS 263 million and misappropriated UZS 594 million in budget funds through embezzlement.

Yesterday, 17:00 1 min read 74 views 0 comments 0 Source: OSCE The OSCE Project Co-ordinator in Uzbekistan and the Supreme Court of Uzbekistan held a two-day training course on legal reporting for journalists, bloggers and court press service representatives in Termez. The training, titled “Justice and Legal Reporting in Media,” focused on international standards for judicial transparency, the presumption of innocence and the legal risks associated with media coverage of court proceedings. Participants worked with international experts Olena Cherniavska, a researcher and expert on media freedom, and Dainius Radzevičius, Lithuania’s media ombudsman, to examine how journalists can report on legal proceedings while protecting individual rights and avoiding defamation. Source: OSCE The sessions included practical case studies, source verification, fact-checking techniques and approaches to explaining complex legal terminology in accessible language. The training also aimed to strengthen communication between journalists and the judiciary, with organizers highlighting the role of professional reporting and open courts in promoting public trust and transparency in the justice system. https://english.news.cn/20261028/ef01eb6.body: China's economy shows resilience, vitality, says Kyrgyz economist-Xinhua China's economy shows resilience, vitality, says Kyrgyz economist Source: Xinhua Editor: huaxia 2026-10-28 13:32:15 An aerial drone photo taken on July 18, 2026 shows a construction site of a subgrade section of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway. (Photo by Ren Weiyun/Xinhua) BISHKEK, Oct. 28 (Xinhua) -- China's economy is demonstrating resilience and vitality through positive development trends despite various challenges, Kyrgyz economist Iskender Sharsheev told Xinhua. In the first three quarters of 2026, China's gross domestic product (GDP) grew 4.6 percent year on year, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics. In the third quarter, China's GDP expanded 4.5 percent year on year, up from 4.3 percent in the previous quarter. "Stable economic growth points to the country's new achievements in high-quality development," Sharsheev said, adding that the growth is driven by favorable trends in high-tech manufacturing, services and exports. He also highlighted the strong performance of China's foreign trade in the first three quarters of 2026. The country's total imports and exports rose by 18.8 percent year on year, according the National Bureau of Statistics. During the same period, trade with countries participating in the China-proposed Belt and Road Initiative surged 17.1 percent. "These results in China's foreign trade are driven by strong demand for its products from advanced sectors, including integrated circuits, electric vehicles and lithium batteries, as well as by market diversification, resilient industrial and supply chains, and the determined implementation of a policy of high-quality opening-up," the economist said. A drone photo taken on Aug. 15, 2026 shows a construction site of a grand bridge above the Kec-Alat River along the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway in Jalalabad, Kyrgyzstan. (Xinhua/Li Renzi) For Kyrgyzstan, a country along the Belt and Road, China's expanding foreign trade presents significant opportunities to increase exports of agricultural products and mineral resources, as well as transit services, Sharsheev said. It also helps attract Chinese investment in infrastructure, logistics and processing industries, while strengthening Kyrgyzstan's role as a regional transport hub, he added. Effectively leveraging these opportunities could help Kyrgyzstan create jobs, boost foreign exchange earnings and speed up its economic modernization, he said. "Foreign trade continues to provide strong support for the industrial sector. The Chinese government has expressed confidence in achieving these goals and retains considerable policy space to introduce targeted stimulus measures. Together, these factors provide a solid foundation for China to meet its year-end economic targets," Sharsheev added. ■ You may like China's research vessel Deep Sea No. 1 visits Naoero Rice harvested in China's Hunan Autumn scenery in Wuhan, China's Hubei Public service centers bring convenience and warmth in Shenzhen In pics: AI-powered restaurant in China's Nanjing Preparations in full swing for 9th CIIE More from GLOBALink My Long March | Giving visitors more reasons to visit where it all began Decoding Party self-governance: Why discipline matters From Long March legacy to shared prosperity: Shazhou Village's transformation

Spokesperson Guo Jiakun made the remarks at a daily news briefing when asked to comment on the U.S. move to place several Chinese companies on a list of businesses over so-called "forced labor" in Xinjiang. Guo said the U.S. side has been continuously fabricating lies related to Xinjiang and using the so-called "forced labor" as an excuse to wantonly suppress Chinese enterprises, adding that China is strongly dissatisfied with and firmly opposed to this. https://www.azernews.az/culture/266433.h.body: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Culture organizes music masterclass in Khachmaz [PHOTOS] 29 October 2026 13:12 (UTC+04:00) By Alimat Aliyeva A series of cultural events titled “Cultural Breeze” is continuing across the region, organized by the Ministry of Culture’s Scientific and Methodological Centre for Culture and Professional Development (MEMIM), with the support of the Guba-Khachmaz Regional Culture Department. According to MEMIM, a masterclass-style meeting with People's Artist of Azerbaijan and associate professor at the Azerbaijan National Conservatory, tar player Elchin Hashimov, was held at the Heydar Aliyev Khachmaz District Cultural Centre as part of the ministry's “Art Dialogue” project. Speaking at the event, MEMIM Acting Director Vuqar Humbatov, a PhD in Art Studies and associate professor, outlined the project's objectives. He said the initiative aims to expand the exchange of experience between prominent artists and young creative talents, promote Azerbaijan's national cultural heritage and support the development of musical arts in the regions. Fuad Orujov, acting head of the Guba-Khachmaz Regional Culture Department, thanked MEMIM for organizing the event in Khachmaz and emphasized the importance of such educational initiatives, particularly for children and young people. During the meeting, moderated by Nicat Hasanazada, head of a MEMIM department, People's Artist Elchin Hashimov discussed ways to enhance young performers' professional skills and theoretical knowledge. He also shared his views on the development of national music, the distinctive characteristics of tar performance and the importance of passing this musical tradition on to future generations. The event continued with performances by Elchin Hashimov; Huseyn Jafarov, a student at the Khachmaz Children's Music School; Polad Amirbalayev, a student at the Guba Children's Art School; and Mehdi Sadigzade, Araz Gasemi and Fateh Iskandar, who study in Hashimov's class at the Azerbaijan National Conservatory. The latter three performers were accompanied on the nagara by Siyavush Karimov. The interactive meeting concluded with Hashimov answering questions from participants. According to the latest reports, at least 68 people died in the accident. На русском языке Yesterday, 21:47 Politics President of Uzbekistan Shavkat Mirziyoyev sent condolences to King Felipe VI of Spain following a train collision that left dozens dead and injured in the province of Toledo, presidential press secretary Sherzod Asadov said . The ehad of state expressed his sympathy to the people of Spain and to the families and loved ones of the victims, and wished the injured a speedy recovery. On the morning of 28 October, two high-speed passenger trains collided in the province of Toledo in central Spain. According to the latest reports, 68 people died and 58 were injured, 15 of whom were in critical condition. https://kloop.kg/blog/2026/10/27/sadyr-z.body: Facebook Twitter VK Telegram WhatsApp Президент Садыр Жапаров, рассказывая жителям Токтогульского района о своем сотрудничестве с Алексеем Ширшовым и вспомнил его партнера — Максима Бакиева, сына второго свергнутого президента Кыргызстана Курманбека Бакиева. Ранее президент заявлял, что Ширшов помогает Кыргызстану возвращать «активы Максима как за рубежом, так и внутри страны». «Оказывается, когда они [Бакиевы] сбежали, все деньги достались Максиму. Он кинул всех своих друзей, и тыйына им не дал. Все остались на улице. Он [Ширшов] говорит, что тот [Максим Бакиев] даже отцу денег не дает. Вот такой он жмот!» — заявил Садыр Жапаров на встрече с жителями Токтогульского района. На фото слева направо: Алексей Ширшов, Максим Бакиев, с правого краю — Санжар Сапарбеков, подозреваемый в убийстве Медета Садыркулова. О каких друзьях Максима Бакиева говорит Садыр Жапаров? После свержения отца в 2010 году, заочно осужденный в Кыргызстане на пожизненное лишение свободы Максим Бакиев бежал в Великобританию, где живет в английском графстве Суррей в поместье за пять миллионов долларов США. Различные бизнесмены позже называли Максима Бакиева рейдером и обвиняли в вымогательстве . Соратниками Максима Бакиева, во времена правления его семьи, были Алексей Ширшов, Евгений Гуревич, Михаил Надель, Алексей Елисеев, Валерий Белоконь. Видимо их президент Жапаров имел в виду, когда говорил про друзей Максима, оставшихся «без единого тыйына». Что известно о якобы брошенных друзьях Максима Бакиева? Михаил Надель Михаил Надель, банкир , бывший председатель « АзияУниверсалБанк ». Несмотря на то, что в Кыргызстане его осудили на 30 лет лишения свободы за соучастие в легализации преступных доходов и мошенничестве, он живет в Великобритании. Надель сменил имя на Майкл Строганов и поучаствовал в создании платежной компании Dzing Finance Ltd . Эта компания в итоге фигурировала в скандалах, связанных с мошенничеством . Управление по финансовому регулированию и надзору Великобритании ввело против нее ограничения , а Надель-Строганов покинул совет директоров компании. Валерий Белоконь Валерий Белоконь, латвийский банкир , выкупивший при правлении Бакиевых кыргызский «Инсан банк» («Манас Банк»). После побега Бакиевых банки перевели на баланс государства, и Белоконь подал на Кыргызстан в международный арбитражный суд и победил. Кыргызстан должен был выплатить ему 16,5 млн долларов. Тогда кыргызские власти сообщили, что подали в Апелляционный суд Парижа, и победили — а выплата Белоконю была отменена. Белоконь это отрицал и настаивал, что долг Кыргызстана растет. В мае 2017 года Первомайский районный суд заочно приговорил экс-главу «Манас Банка» Валерия Белоконя к 20 годам лишения свободы с конфискацией имущества за отмывание преступных доходов. В Латвии Белоконь известен как совладелец Baltic International Bank — и этот банк подозревают в отмывании 20 млн евро , полученных преступным путем. Банку аннулировали лицензию, он закрыт , а Белоконю грозит 12 лет лишения свободы. Алексей Елисеев Алексей Елисеев, юрист и соратник Максима Бакиева, покинувший Кыргызстан и осевший в Латвии после 2020 года. Экс-замглавы Центрального агентства Кыргызской Республики по развитию, инвестициям и инновациям (ЦАРИИ) Елисеева суд в Кыргызстане заочно приговорил к 30 годам лишения свободы. Помимо прочего, Елисеев был зампредом совета директоров «АзияУниверсалБанк» (АУБ), председателем которого был Михаил Надель. Согласно материалам уголовных дел против соратников Максима Бакиева, сотрудничал Елисеев и с людьми Белоконя. Евгений Гуревич Евгений Гуревич, бывший советник Максима Бакиева. Гуревич был международным бизнес- консультантом в Нью-Йорке , а в 2008 году основал кыргызский инвестиционный банк MGN , был советником руководства АУБ. Гуревич публично рассказал , что Бакиевы якобы вывели $200-300 млн из Кыргызстана. Он также утверждал, что благодаря его содействию США вернул в Кыргызстан $6 млн из этих денег. Эти деньги из страны выводили в 2012-2013 годах с помощью оффшорной компании в Гонконге, которая неофициально принадлежала Бакиевым. После апрельской революции 2010 года Гуревич улетел из Кыргызстана сначала в Беларусь, предположительно на частном самолете Максима Бакиева, а потом в США. Там его осудили за мошенничество и он провел пять лет в тюрьме штата Алабама. В Кыргызстане Гуревича тоже осудили, но заочно. Вместе с Максимом Бакиевым его признали виновным в нарушении финансового законодательства и мошенничестве при выводе средств из Соцфонда. Алексей Ширшов, финансовый консультант Максима Бакиева. После свержения Бакиевых тоже бежал из страны, был в Латвии, а также Украине и России. В 2021 году Ширшов вернулся в Кыргызстан и, как утверждает президент, помог государству вернуть часть активов семьи Бакиевых. В 2022 году, когда Ширшова сначала задержал ГКНБ по делу о коррупции, а затем суд отпустил его под домашний арест, Садыр Жапаров заявлял , что против Ширшова нет действующих уголовных дел и он не находится в розыске — хотя многочисленные свидетельства говорили об обратном. Сейчас Ширшов выстраивает себе образ мецената. Его активно защищает президент Садыр Жапаров, настаивая, что тот якобы помогает вернуть в Кыргызстан выведенные Бакиевыми средства, и что Максим Бакиев «бросил» Ширшова. При этом 25 октября во время визита в Джалал-Абадскую область президент подтвердил данные расследования «Клоопа», который еще три года назад сообщал, что на «Камбар-Ате 2» занимается майнингом компания, связанная с Бакиевым и и косвенно с Ширшовыс. Жапаров сообщил, что лично предложил Алексею Ширшову установить майнинг-ферму на «Камбар Ате 2». Взятки от семьи Максима Курманбек Бакиев с семьей Курманбек Бакиев — второй свергнутый кыргызский президент, заочно осужденный в стране на 30 лет лишения свободы, живет с семьей в Беларуси. Там поселились все члены клана, кроме семьи Максима Бакиева. На встрече с жителями Токтогульского района, президент Садыр Жапаров заявил , что якобы Максим Бакиев — «жмот» и не хочет помогать отцу. Однако, по данным Объединения бывших силовиков Беларуси BYPOL, супруга Максима Бакиева Айжан Кененбаева ранее передала президенту Беларуси Александру Лукашенко транспортные средства на сумму не менее $1,6 млн в качестве взятки за покровительство. «Казалось бы, за что так благодарна чужая жена престарелому взяточнику? Разумеется, за покровительство и укрывательство в Беларуси семьи Бакиевых от правосудия, ожидающих у себя на родине. За неизменный отказ официального Минска на запросы Бишкека об экстрадиции преступников», — уверены в BYPOL. В Беларуси Курманбек Бакиев сначала жил в президентской резиденции «Плавно», а затем переехал в элитный район Минска «Дрозды» . Старший сын Бакиева Марат проживает в Беларуси в элитной деревне Раубичи . Кроме того, «Альянс расследователей Беларуси» выяснил , что Курманбек Бакиев получил в Беларуси новый паспорт на имя Закира Салиева. Получили новые документы и другие члены клана. Все это позволяет им свободно путешествовать по миру. ЭТО МОЖЕТ БЫТЬ ИНТЕРЕСНО ЕЩЕ ОТ АВТОРА Садыр Жапаров признал, что Алексей Ширшов стоит за майнингом на Камбар-Ате 2. «Клооп» писал об этом еще три года назад Ширшов и 7 млрд сомов на благоустройство Каракола. За чей счет банкет? Хотим заступиться за Жапарова. Он действительно может баллотироваться в президенты не покидая должность и эту норму ввели задолго до его правления

Facebook Twitter VK Telegram WhatsApp 25 октября во время визита в Джалал-Абадскую область президент Садыр Жапаров в очередной раз похвалил автора бакиевских коррупционных схем в энергетике Алексея Ширшова. «Ширшов был партнером [сына президента Курманбека Бакиева] Максима в 2005–2010 годы, до бегства Бакиевых, вы все его знаете, — напомнил глава государства во время встречи с жителями Токтогульского района. — Они вместе управляли энергосистемой. И на самом деле они воровали. Привозили трансформатор за 100 тысяч долларов, а передавали по цене в 1 миллион долларов. Разницу забирали себе». При Бакиевых Алексей Ширшов был финансовым директором госкомпаний «Северэлектро» и «Электрические станции» и считался одним из самых близких друзей Максима Бакиева. В 2010 году он бежал из страны. За границей, по словам Садыра Жапарова, Ширшов смог встать на ноги, ведя бизнес с неназванными олигархами из России и Европы. В 2021 году Ширшов вернулся на родину и, как утверждает президент, помог государству вернуть часть активов семьи Бакиевых. В 2022 году, когда Ширшова сначала задержал ГКНБ по делу о коррупции, а затем суд отпустил его под домашний арест, Садыр Жапаров заявлял , что против Ширшова нет действующих уголовных дел и он не находится в розыске — хотя многочисленные свидетельства говорили об обратном. Теперь президент заявляет , что он сам предложил Ширшову заняться майнингом на государственной электростанции «Камбар-Ата 2». Жапаров напомнил , что из 120 МВт мощности «Камбар-Аты 2» 90 МВт направляется в энергосистему Кыргызстана, а оставшиеся 30 МВт невозможно передать в сеть из-за нехватки пропускной способности ЛЭП и трансформаторов. Поэтому он, Жапаров, предложил Ширшову вложить $30-35 миллионов, чтобы использовать эти запертые 30 мегаватт для майнинга. «Используй 4-5 лет, чтобы возместить свои затраты, а как возместишь, то передай [майнинговую ферму — прим. ред.] государству бесплатно. Этот майнинг заставил его установить я. Два года уже прошло. Еще через два он передаст майнинг на баланс НЭСК», — заявил Садыр Жапаров. Заявления президента в очередной раз подтвердили данные расследования «Клоопа» «Тариф «Охреневший»», опубликованного в июле 2023 года. Тогда мы обнаружили скрытое постановление Кабмина No303 от 16 июня 2023 года, по которому косвенно связанная с Алексеем Ширшовым компания «МБТ Строй» получила право использовать 30 МВт «Камбар-Аты 2» для майнинга. Этот документ нарушал запрет на использование государственной электроэнергии для майнинга. Мало того, как выяснил тогда «Клооп», электроэнергию «МБТ Строй» получала по 60 тыйынов за 1 кВт/час — это в шесть раз дешевле, чем для населения. И это при том, что тариф для майнеров в Кыргызстане превышал на тот момент 5 сомов за 1 кВт/час. Сейчас Садыр Жапаров об этом не упоминает. 6 июля 2023 года в Минэнерго Кыргызстана подтвердили точность опубликованных «Клоопом» данных и добавили, что «МБТ Строй» получит право использовать 30 МВт «Камбар-Аты 2» для майнинга в течение 10 лет. Это противоречит нынешним словам Садыра Жапарова о четырех-пяти годах. Постановление Кабмина предполагает, что майнинговая компания Ширшова модернизирует инфраструктуру «Камбар-Аты 2». А именно — инвестирует деньги в новые ЛЭП и трансформаторную подстанцию для высвобождения заблокированных 30 МВт и их передачи в энергосистему страны. Инвестиции в правительстве тогда оценили в 1,5 млрд сомов . Но летом 2025 года «Клооп» выяснил , что вместо новых трансформаторов «МБТ Строй» поставила на ГЭС трансформаторы, отработавшие 20 лет, при этом завысив их стоимость в 34 раза. Это повторяет схему бакиевских времен, о которой Садыр Жапаров вспоминал на встрече с жителями Токтогульского района 25 октября: «Привозили трансформатор за 100 тысяч долларов, а передавали по цене в 1 миллион долларов». И прямо нарушает обещание президента не создавать с Алексеем Ширшовым серых схем в энергетике. Вложился ли Ширшов в новые линии электропередач для разблокировки запертой мощности ГЭС «Камбар-Ата 2» и ее передачи в энергосистему страны, президент не уточнил. С его слов выходит, что 30 мегаватт просто отдали для майнинга бывшему другу и партнеру Максима Бакиева. Президентские оправдания майнинговых схем Алексея Ширшова звучат на фоне сохраняющегося дефицита электроэнергии в Кыргызстане. «Сейчас у нас действует ограничение на потребление электроэнергии: при превышении лимита в 5 киловатт электричество отключается, — обратился житель Токтогульского района к Садыру Жапарову на той же встрече 25 октября. — Если возможно, снимите это ограничение или хотя бы немного увеличьте лимит». В ответ Садыр Жапаров попросил собравшихся потерпеть еще два или два с половиной года, пока будут построены новые электростанции. ЭТО МОЖЕТ БЫТЬ ИНТЕРЕСНО ЕЩЕ ОТ АВТОРА Садыр Жапаров: Максим Бакиев — жмот, не дал денег ни друзьям, ни отцу Ширшов и 7 млрд сомов на благоустройство Каракола. За чей счет банкет? Хотим заступиться за Жапарова. Он действительно может баллотироваться в президенты не покидая должность и эту норму ввели задолго до его правления

https://www.rferl.org/a/crimea-drone-str.body: Russia Invades Ukraine Why Russia's Central Crimean Drone Base Is Hard For Ukraine To Destroy October 27, 2026 21:36 CET By Serhiy Koval , RFE/RL's Crimea.Realities and Amos Chapple A section of the Hvardiyske airfield showing militry jets in December 2021 (left), and structures linked to drone launches on October 11, 2026 (right). Photo: Google Earth, Planet Labs (©) Russia Invades Ukraine Why Russia's Central Crimean Drone Base Is Hard For Ukraine To Destroy October 27, 2026 21:36 CET By Serhiy Koval , RFE/RL's Crimea.Realities and Amos Chapple Why Russia's Central Crimean Drone Base Is Hard For Ukraine To Destroy Share Copy link Facebook X (Twitter) LinkedIn Email Share Share Copy link Facebook X (Twitter) LinkedIn Email Share Prefer us on Google A military airfield in Crimea has been transformed into a hub for drone launches, new satellite images sourced by RFE/RL show. Hvardiyske airfield, in the center of the Russian-occupied Ukrainian peninsula, was first identified as a launch site for attack drones in March 2025 and is now used almost daily for strikes, according to Ukraine’s military. The base is known as Gvardeiskoye in Russian. An image of the site made on October 11 shows no visible military aircraft, but extensive new infrastructure, which observers say is related to drone launches from the Soviet-era airbase. The transformation of the Hvardiyske base has raised questions over why Kyiv has not been able to disable the site with its own attack drones and missiles. A section of the Hvardiyske airfield seen on October 11, 2026 (top) and June 2024. Ukraine has frequently hit Russian drone storage and launch facilities in Crimea, including on the remote southeastern Cape Chauda and near Balaklava in a strike that reportedly took the site out of action. Hvardiyske has been hit by Ukrainian drones but damage has been minimal. A Crimean local and former officer of the Ukrainian military spoke with RFE/RL’s Crimean Service on condition of anonymity about possible reasons why the sprawling drone port at Hvardiyske has not yet been disabled by Ukraine’s own attack drones. “In my opinion, the main reason is that drone operations there are spread across different parts of the airfield," he said. "The launch site is in one location, the maintenance area in another, and the storage facilities are in a third.” “All of this is relatively simple infrastructure that can be easily restored, and some of it is just standing out in the open," he added. In the October 11 satellite image sourced by RFE/RL (above), scores of unidentified objects can be seen spaced several meters apart on open grassland in the southwestern corner of the airbase. A 2012 image of the Hvardiyske air base. The former Ukrainian Armed Forces officer told RFE/RL that an underground storage facility built by the Soviets to store aircraft munitions, which is located around 15 kilometers from the Hvardiyske base, is a likely location for the mass storage of attack drones launched from the airfield. "The Shaheds may well be hiding there," he told RFE/RL, speculating that such a fortified storage space "is probably impossible to penetrate, even with [Ukraine's] missiles." Another reason Hvardiyske may present a more difficult objective for Ukrainian targeteers is its location in the center of Crimea, a peninsula now bristling with air defense weaponry. Unlike coastal launch sites, which can be approached from over the sea, Ukrainian drones aiming for Hvardiyske “have to fly about 100 kilometers over land to strike this facility, where the likelihood of being shot down is higher,” the source said. A file photo of Shahed drones stored in sheds in Russia's Oryol region. The Iranian-designed, long-range attack drones have been widely used by Russia to strike targets in Ukraine, with Moscow also producing its own versions. The Hvardiyske air base served as a Soviet, then Ukrainian, naval aviation base. Following the Russian annexation of Crimea, the facility was taken over by the Russian Aerospace Forces, which stationed Su-24M bombers and Su-25SM ground-attack jet aircraft at the base until its transformation into a drone port. https://www.rferl.org/a/trump-zelenskyy-.body: News Trump Hopeful Of Zelenskyy-Putin Meeting 'Very Soon' By RFE/RL October 28, 2026 10:23 CET Trump Hopeful Of Zelenskyy-Putin Meeting 'Very Soon' Share Copy link Facebook X (Twitter) LinkedIn Email Share Share Copy link Facebook X (Twitter) LinkedIn Email Share Prefer us on Google Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy (left), US Presdient Donald Trump (center) and Russian President Vladimir Putin (composite file photo) US President Donald Trump told reporters on October 28 that a meeting between the Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and his Russian counterpart, Vladimir Putin, will be set up "very soon." Trump didn’t specify a specific date or venue for the potential meeting but did add that “a lot of progress could be made.” A G20 summit that Trump is hosting in Florida in December presents a potential opportunity for a face-to-face meeting between the Ukrainian and Russian leaders, but Putin has yet to respond to a US invitation and he and Zelenskyy have differed starkly on the prospects for such a meeting. Putin has sought to cast doubt on Zelenskyy’s legitimacy and has repeatedly said the presidents could only meet when a comprehensive peace deal has been agreed, though he has also suggested he and Zelenskyy could meet in Moscow. The Kremlin knows that the prospect of a meeting in the capital of the country that is attacking Ukraine is unacceptable to Kyiv. Zelenskyy has expressed readiness to meet with Putin in a third country, and has said crucial issues such as territory can only be decided at the leadership level. It was previously announced that trilateral technical-level talks were planned for the first half of November in the United Arab Emirates. The American president’s comments come just a day after the Finnish President Alexander Stubb and the Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store held a 90-minute-phone call with Putin to discuss Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. The Nordic leaders also spoke to Zelenskyy over the phone. In a press statement, Stubb noted that “the discussion was frank and substantive." "We are neighboring countries to Russia. The outcome of this war will have a direct impact on our and the broader European security. Ending the war requires direct discussions," the Finnish president added. SEE ALSO: After Oslo Talks, Zelenskyy Thanks US As Missile Intelligence 'Works Now' Store had hosted Zelenskyy, Trump’s special envoy Steve Witkoff, and several European officials in Oslo on October 20 in an effort to ensure European countries have a role in negotiations to end Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. The flurry of Western diplomatic activity comes as Vladimir Putin earlier in October proposed a three-way summit with the United States and the Chinese leader, Xi Jinping, toward the end of the year to conclude the war. Trump said on October 19 that he was open to meeting Putin and Xi on the sidelines of an Asia-Pacific summit in China in November, although he suggested the main focus would be nuclear disarmament rather than Ukraine. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio subsequently confirmed that discussions about a possible meeting had taken place but said arrangements had not been finalized. The prospect of talks on Ukraine without Kyiv's participation has raised concerns, with Ukrainian officials insisting that their country must have a seat at the negotiating table. Oleshky Cease-Fire Holds Meanwhile both Ukraine and Russia confirmed that there had been no breaches of the US-negotiated ⁠local cease-fire around the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky ⁠in southern Ukraine in its first 30 hours. https://www.rferl.org/a/serbia-srdanovic.body: Serbia 'Committed To European Integration': Student List's Srdanovic On Serbia's Post-Vucic Future By Milos Teodorovic October 27, 2026 19:58 CET 'Committed To European Integration': Student List's Srdanovic On Serbia's Post-Vucic Future Share Copy link Facebook X (Twitter) LinkedIn Email Share Share Copy link Facebook X (Twitter) LinkedIn Email Share Prefer us on Google The Student List's lead candidate Ilija Srdanovic celebrates the news that Serbia's ruling party conceded defeat in parliamentary elections in Belgrade on October 25. Aleksandar Vucic’s election defeat has ended more than a decade of political dominance and handed victory to Serbia’s student-led opposition movement. But many questions remain: Who will lead the next government? Can the protest movement turn electoral success into stable rule? And what could the result mean for Serbia’s relations with the European Union and Russia? RFE/RL's Balkan Service spoke with Ilija Srdanovic -- a cardiologist and university professor who was the lead candidate for the Student List electoral grouping that emerged from Serbia's anti-government protests -- about what comes next for both the movement and the country. The interview has been edited for length and clarity. RFE/RL: Mr. Srdanovic, how does it feel to be the leader of a list that has no leader, so to speak? Ilija Srdanovic: Above all, I feel proud. I'm proud of all our citizens who saw the Student List as a way out of the situation Serbia had been in for years, living under the repressive system of an authoritarian government dominated by one man. That man has now passed into political history, having left an indelible mark of emptiness on our history for 15 years... RFE/RL: When will it be publicly known who will be the candidate for prime minister and who will be the candidates for ministers? Srdanovic: At this moment, I can give you the following answer: that the Republic Election Commission has not yet announced the final results of our elections. From the final results of the electoral process -- which will not differ from the projections based on representative samples or the ballots processed so far -- the number of mandates will be more or less what it is. However, the elections officially end the moment the Republic Election Commission announces the election results in accordance with the law. From that moment, conditions are met for the next procedure, which is the formation of the new parliament, parliamentary bodies, and after that, a plan for forming the government. SEE ALSO: After More Than A Decade Of Vucic, What Comes Next For Serbia? RFE/RL: Will the name of the candidate for prime minister be determined within the Student List, or will you again seek consultations with forums at the faculties ( university-based forums through which students organized and made collective decisions in the protest movement that gave rise to Student List) ? Srdanovic: The government will be formed in accordance with Serbia's laws and regulations. The choice of individuals for government posts will be made by the majority group of lawmakers from the Student List. RFE/RL: Would you be ready to accept a potential candidacy? As the list leader, it seems logical somehow. Srdanovic: Yes, but as you said at the beginning of our conversation, this is a list without a leader. We can say the following: For every position, we will collectively choose the candidate we believe will best serve the interests of Serbia's citizens. SEE ALSO: Who's In Charge? The Faces Of Serbia's Student-Backed Political Movement RFE/RL: Will you remain committed to European integration? Will you accelerate the process? Srdanovic: We remain committed to European integration. Serbia committed itself to this process back in 2000, 26 years ago. That work will continue. But what we can certainly promise is that we will not repeat what the previous government did: losing 20 percent of public support for European integration over 15 years. That is the net outcome, the ultimate result of the previous government's policies. We will certainly, on the basis of the same civilizational values -- respect for rights and equality, anti-corruption measures, the functioning of institutions, and media freedom -- fully align our country's domestic policy with Chapters 23 and 24 [of EU accession negotiations], which are the main obstacles to further progress toward European integration. The Student List has stated that it will not impose sanctions on Russia. Doesn't something have to change? What will change in Serbia's relations with Moscow? Srdanovic: First of all, as I said in my previous answer, the main condition for further European integration, and currently the biggest obstacle, concerns Chapters 23 and 24, which deal with human rights and the rule of law. Unfortunately, until now, Serbia has lacked fundamental values such as freedom, rights, democracy, and media freedom. There has been no dialogue. Our citizens do not have complete information about what the European Union actually offers them. A large number of citizens have been confined to a restricted media environment in which they have been fed falsehoods for more than a decade and a half. As a result, they do not even fully understand the EU's agenda. Many of our citizens are simply uninformed. RFE/RL: Are you suggesting that Serbia's relationship with Russia will also be reconsidered through public dialogue? Srdanovic: There will certainly be a dialogue within our society. Foreign policy must be shaped in accordance with the demands and the will of the majority of citizens, not the opinion of one person..." All questions concerning international relations must be addressed through open dialogue among our citizens. These policies cannot be shaped by a single individual. We have worked to ensure, and succeeded in ensuring, that a system in which one person decides where we are heading as a nation will never again take hold in Serbia. We will open a dialogue and give our citizens the opportunity to choose the direction they believe is best for them. But that dialogue must be open and transparent, rather than shaped by the regime, as has been the case for the past 15 to 20 years. RFE/RL: So, if I understand you correctly, Serbia's position on sanctions against Russia could be reconsidered? Srdanovic: It could mean that the citizens of Serbia will ultimately decide on that relationship. RFE/RL: How? Through a referendum? Help me understand. Srdanovic: In much the same way as with relations with other countries. Foreign policy must be shaped in accordance with the demands and the will of the majority of citizens, not the opinion of one person or a very small group of people making decisions on their behalf. That is not democracy. RFE/RL: The Student List has taken a clear position on Kosovo. But will you continue the dialogue with Kosovo aimed at normalizing relations? (The Student List opposes recognizing Kosovo , in line with Serbia’s official position since Pristina declared independence in 2008) Srdanovic: Continuing the dialogue on Kosovo and Metohija is a fundamental part of the students' plan. Our entire platform for Serbia's domestic and international relations is based on respect for the constitution of the Republic of Serbia. Therefore, our platform for talks on Kosovo and Metohija, including its future, is also in line with Serbia's constitution.
